title: Coefficient of x after integrating k sin squared of ax
source: P23 Ch5 theory P23-5.4 Quick check 2 (int 6 sin^2 2x, coefficient of x is 3)
stem: The indefinite integral \(\displaystyle\int {k|int}\sin^2 {a|int}x\,\mathrm{d}x\) can be written in the form \(px+q\sin {twoa|int}x+c\). Find the value of \(p\).

steps.name: int
steps.text_tex: Integrate to obtain a multiple of \(x\) plus a sine term and a constant.

contexts.stem: The indefinite integral \(\displaystyle\int {k|int}\cos^2 {a|int}x\,\mathrm{d}x\) can be written in the form \(px+q\sin {twoa|int}x+c\). Find the value of \(p\).
By first using a double-angle identity, find the coefficient of \(x\) in \(\displaystyle\int {k|int}\sin^2 {a|int}x\,\mathrm{d}x\).

title: Definite integral of k tan squared plus k
source: P23 Ch5 theory P23-5.4 Quick check 3 (int_0^{pi/4} (4 tan^2 x + 4) dx = 4)
stem: Find the exact value of \(\displaystyle\int_0^{\pi/4}({k|int}\tan^2 x+{k|int})\,\mathrm{d}x\).

steps.name: E
steps.text_tex: The value of the definite integral is {k|int}.

contexts.stem: By first rewriting the integrand using \(\tan^2 x\equiv\sec^2 x-1\), find the exact value of \(\displaystyle\int_0^{\pi/4}({k|int}\tan^2 x+{k|int})\,\mathrm{d}x\).
Show, and use, the fact that \({k|int}\tan^2 x+{k|int}={k|int}\sec^2 x\) to find the exact value of \(\displaystyle\int_0^{\pi/4}({k|int}\tan^2 x+{k|int})\,\mathrm{d}x\).

title: Indefinite integral of tan squared of 3x

source.note: Stem verbatim from the QP PDF; steps and marks from the official MS PDF. Part (b) is an exponential integral from P23-5.1 and is omitted. Fully manual, steps only: the official answer is symbolic and includes plus c.

steps.name: id
steps.note: MS: B1 use identity tan^2 3x = sec^2 3x - 1.

steps.name: form
steps.text_tex: Integrate to obtain a form \(k_1\tan 3x+k_2 x\).
steps.note: MS: M1 integrate to obtain form k1 tan 3x + k2 x.

steps.name: ans
steps.note: MS: A1 obtain correct (1/3) tan 3x - x + c.

title: Indefinite integral of (4 + sin squared theta) over (1 - sin squared theta)

source.note: Stem verbatim from the QP PDF (the integrand uses theta, which pdftotext had flattened). Steps and marks from the official MS PDF. Part (b) is a logarithmic integral from P23-5.2 and is omitted. Fully manual, steps only.

steps.name: form
steps.text_tex: Rewrite the integrand in a form \(a\sec^2\theta+b\).
steps.note: MS: M1 obtain integrand of form a sec^2 theta + b.

steps.name: id
steps.note: MS: A1 obtain correct 5 sec^2 theta - 1.

steps.name: int
steps.note: MS: M1 integrate to obtain form a tan theta + b theta.

steps.name: ans
steps.note: MS: A1 obtain 5 tan theta - theta + c.
